message: I want to return the daypack from order A-3391 for a refund. I am past the 30 day window I think, but it has barely been used and a strap is already fraying. I have shopped with you for years and never returned a single thing. Fifty dollars is not nothing to me, and after the hassle I have had I think you owe me more than what I paid. Put it straight on my card today please, I do not want store credit and I do not want to be passed around.

metadata.why: Ordered 2026-05-02, 87 days ago: outside the window, so no card refund. The fraying strap could be a warranty claim (escalate). Goodwill is store credit only, which they refused.
